deckTitle: MedKayfab Urology Wrestling: The Renal Reservoir

cards.power: The Exit-Squeeze. Grows inward in the Transition-Alley, narrowing the Urethra-Tunnel.
cards.lore: Driven by DHT. Stromal/epithelial cells multiply, causing Frequency-Fires and Hesitation-Halt.
cards.gradeReason: Gatekeeper squeezing the Urethra-Tunnel — IPSS and DHT mechanism baked into name and power.
cards.artworkPrompt: Angry gorilla blocking pipe tunnel pushing walls inward. Clinical, brown stone, visceral tension.

cards.power: The Tunnel-Block. Wedges in the Ureter-Tube, triggering Peristalsis-Panic and Colic-Scream.
cards.lore: Solute saturation. Low Fluid-Tokens = crystals precipitate. Danger point: UVJ-Border-Crossing.
cards.gradeReason: Colic-Scream at the UVJ — stone passage biology in two vivid moves.
cards.artworkPrompt: Golden crystalline armadillo wedged in pink ureter tunnel, shockwaves of pain radiating. Bright, dramatic.

cards.power: The Back-Flow-Hammer. Downstream block forces fluid into the Kidney-Fortress, crushing Filter-Gears.
cards.lore: Obstructive Uropathy. Intrarenal pressure exceeds Glomerular-Filtration-Force.
cards.gradeReason: Puffer fish swelling in stone fountain is brilliant visual, but Back-Flow-Hammer needs one beat.
cards.artworkPrompt: Puffer fish inflating inside overflowing stone fountain. Blue-grey, dramatic pressure buildup, waterlogged.

cards.power: The Narrowing-Trap. A Fibro-Fiona scar-wall turns a Highway into a Thread-Thin-Path.
cards.lore: Inflammation-Incursion. Spongiofibrosis creates a permanent, non-elastic segment.
cards.gradeReason: Fibro-Fiona scar-wall is inspired. Thread-Thin-Path makes urethra stricture visceral.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dark scar tissue lattice strangling a blue fluid highway down to a thread. Monochromatic grey, tight.

cards.power: The Red-Mist. Grows along Bladder-Wallpaper, causing Blood-Leak before digging deep.
cards.lore: The Field-Effect. Carcinogens touch every inch of the Basin-Wall.
cards.gradeReason: Red-Mist creeping along Bladder-Wallpaper — painless hematuria and field effect in one image.
cards.artworkPrompt: Red serpentine creature crawling along pink bladder wall trailing blood mist. Unsettling, visceral, smoky.

cards.power: The Stealth-Grower. Starts in the Outer-Plains. Hides until hitting the Bone-Arena.
cards.lore: Androgen-dependent. Exploits Testosterone-Signal to expand and breach Capsule.
cards.gradeReason: Hiding in Outer-Plains until Bone-Arena — silent peripheral zone prostate CA in two moves.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dark bat crouching behind enormous smooth mass at organ periphery. Purple shadow. Ominous silence.

cards.power: The VHL-Vandal. Builds own Blood-Pipe-Network to break into the Renal-Vein-River.
cards.lore: VHL-Blueprint-Glitch. Creates Erythropoietin-Sparks, raising RBC count.
cards.gradeReason: VHL-Vandal building Blood-Pipes is brilliant. Erythropoietin-Sparks adds paraneoplastic nuance.
cards.artworkPrompt: Flaming wolverine smashing kidney fortress walls while building glowing red vein networks. Orange fire.

cards.power: The Youth-Invasion. Massive encapsulated tumor taking over the Kidney-Arena.
cards.lore: Blastema cell failure. Primitive warriors refuse to differentiate into mature filters.
cards.gradeReason: Rhino holding Do Not Palpate sign is Grade 1 visual. Power text earns the G2.
cards.artworkPrompt: Chubby purple rhinoceros holding Do Not Palpate sign inside pink organ arena. Gentle, pediatric.

cards.power: The Blood-Choke. Twists Spermatic-Cord, cutting Arterial-Flow. Arena dies.
cards.lore: Bell-Clapper-Deformity. Lacks anchor to Scrotal-Wall, spinning and trapping supply lines.
cards.gradeReason: Arena dies. Two words. The 6-hour window is baked into the emergency.
cards.artworkPrompt: Otter violently twisting a cord attached to a darkening purple orb amid orange fire. Urgent, alarming.

cards.power: The Heat-Trap. Vein-Valves fail, pooling blood. Raises Arena-Temp, sabotaging Sperm-Knights.
cards.lore: Nutcracker-Effect. Left-Renal-Vein squeezed, causing back-pressure in Scrotal-Veins.
cards.gradeReason: Heat-Trap sabotaging Sperm-Knights — left-side varicocele fertility impact in one card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Tangled blue serpents coiled around pink mass, radiating heat shimmer. Left-heavy, warm red tones.

cards.power: The Rapid-Replacement. Painless, heavy mass replaces normal tissue with solid Armor-Block.
cards.lore: Germ-cell riot. Highly Radiation-Sensitive — melts when hit by Roentgen-Rays.
cards.gradeReason: Melts when hit by Roentgen-Rays — treatment sensitivity in five words. Perfect G1.
cards.artworkPrompt: White owl inside glowing pink mass dissolving under purple radiation beams. Serene, clinical, radiosensitive.

cards.power: The Fluid-Buffer. Scrotal-Fortress fills with clear fluid. Giant but Weightless-and-Soft.
cards.lore: Failure to close Abdominal-Gateway, letting Peritoneal-Water leak down.
cards.gradeReason: Giant but Weightless-and-Soft — transillumination distinguisher versus tumor in three words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Delicate jellyfish floating inside transparent fluid-filled sac encasing tiny kidney. Blue, translucent, calm.

cards.power: The Wall-Irritant. Bacteria colonize Bladder-Lining, causing Frequency-Fires.
cards.lore: Short Urethra-Tunnels in Female-Knights. Pili-Hooks resist wash-out.
cards.gradeReason: Frequency-Fires from colonized Bladder-Lining. Name equals diagnosis. No translation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green frog horde with hooks charging through burning pink bladder wall. Chaotic, hot, urgent.

cards.power: The High-Invasion. Travels up Ureter-Tunnels to attack Kidney-Fortress, causing Systemic-Shock.
cards.lore: Ascending infection triggers Neutrophil-Riot, risking permanent Scar-Ruins.
cards.gradeReason: Up Ureter-Tunnels to the Fortress — ascending path plus Scar-Ruins severity baked in.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green bat horde breaching burning stone kidney castle through pink tunnel. Fire, siege, systemic chaos.

cards.power: The Glandular-Glow. Prostate-Gate becomes swollen and Angry-Red. Painful Fluid-Exit.
cards.lore: Bacterial-Sanctuary. Prostate-Armor blocks Antibiotic-Artillery; requires long treatment.
cards.gradeReason: Bacterial-Sanctuary inside Prostate-Armor — antibiotic penetration failure in one image.
cards.artworkPrompt: Red bulldog biting glowing catheter tube while flames pour off its back. Furious red glow.

cards.power: The Flesh-Melt. Bacterial-Fire-Storm eats through Scrotal-Armor in hours.
cards.lore: Polymicrobial sabotage. Toxin-Gas creates skin bubbles and kills Blood-Supply-Roads.
cards.gradeReason: Flesh-Melt eats Scrotal-Armor in hours. Necrotizing fasciitis emergency in one move.
cards.artworkPrompt: Black raven of destruction surrounded by grey-black gas clouds consuming a body arena. Dark, urgent.

cards.power: The Premature-Squeeze. Bladder-Muscle spasms without warning before Sanitary-Zone.
cards.lore: Neuro-Misfire. Nerves shout EMPTY NOW even when Reservoir is mostly empty.
cards.gradeReason: Nerves shout EMPTY NOW. That IS overactive bladder — no translation needed.
cards.artworkPrompt: Frantic white rabbit squeezing pink water balloon mid-sprint, colorful splashing everywhere. Urgent, comedic.

cards.power: The Valve-Fail. Rising Abdominal-Pressure overwhelms failing Pelvic-Floor; Gate opens.
cards.lore: Loss of mechanical support for Urethra-Tunnel, often post-childbirth.
cards.gradeReason: Elephant on balloon valve — abdominal pressure mechanism made visible. Post-childbirth context completes.
cards.artworkPrompt: Elephant sitting on pink balloon causing valve to spring open, water spraying. Yellow-peach soft tones.

cards.power: The Reservoir-Burst. Overfilled with Static-Fluid, it simply Leaks-at-the-Edges. Obstructive or Atonic bladder.
cards.lore: Wall stretched too thin to execute Squeeze-to-Victory.
cards.gradeReason: Sloth too slow to squeeze — atonic plus overflow dribbling in one perfect beast.
cards.artworkPrompt: Sleepy sloth hugging enormous overfull glass container leaking from every edge. Pastel, drooping, slow.

cards.power: The Disconnect. Brain-Bunker and Bladder-Fortress stop communicating. Loss of Pontine-Micturition-Center signal.
cards.lore: Squeeze and Gate fire simultaneously.
cards.gradeReason: Squeeze and Gate fire simultaneously — dyssynergia in five words. Robot tortoise sells disconnection.
cards.artworkPrompt: Robotic armored tortoise with severed glowing cable trailing behind it. Blue and grey, disconnected.

cards.power: The Inner-Melt. A Loop-of-Fire carves away the Gatekeeper-Gland from the inside out.
cards.lore: Re-opening Urethra-Highway by creating a Wide-Open-Funnel to restore flow.
cards.gradeReason: Loop-of-Fire carves from inside out — TURP mechanism in one golden electric eel.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electric golden eel crackling with blue arcs carving through stone tunnel walls. Gold, electric blue.

cards.power: The Bypass-Pipe. Flexible tube bypasses Obstruction-Outlaws to empty Reservoir.
cards.lore: Inflatable-Water-Balloon anchors it inside the bladder. Essential for Retention-Crises.
cards.gradeReason: Bypass-Pipe with Balloon-Anchor — Foley catheter mechanics in anatomy-accurate cross-section.
cards.artworkPrompt: Blue snake coiled inside anatomical bladder cross-section with glowing blue balloon anchor. Clinical blue.

cards.power: The Sonic-Hammer. High-energy Sound-Bursts travel through body to smash the Stone.
cards.lore: Acoustic cavitation. Shatters the crystalline lattice without a single Blade-Cut.
cards.gradeReason: Without a single Blade-Cut — non-invasive lithotripsy principle in six words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Mechanical bat firing spiral sonic wave beam at glowing crystal stone near kidney. Blue energy spiral.

cards.power: The Tunnel-Prop. Keeps Ureter-Highway open, allowing flow even if Wall is swollen.
cards.lore: Curl-at-Both-Ends prevents stent from migrating up or down the pipe.
cards.gradeReason: Curl-at-Both-Ends preventing migration — Double-J stent design embedded in the metaphor.
cards.artworkPrompt: Teal coiled stent bridge connecting kidney and bladder anatomy in cross-section. Clean, clinical blue.

cards.power: The Adrenaline-Flood. Adrenal-Basement tumor sprays Combat-Hormones into blood.
cards.lore: Chromaffin cell riot. Palpating the flank can trigger the Hormone-Grenade.
cards.gradeReason: Palpating triggers the Hormone-Grenade — critical clinical danger warning embedded in lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Electrified squirrel erupting yellow lightning bolts radiating in all directions. Orange, electric, frantic.

cards.power: The Fluid-Hoarder. Tells Kidney-Filters to Keep-the-Salt and Dump-the-Potassium.
cards.lore: Adrenal Cortex adenoma bypasses feedback loops. An independent Pressure-Engine.
cards.gradeReason: Keep-the-Salt, Dump-the-Potassium — Conn's electrolyte effects in eight words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Gold raccoon throwing potassium coins into trash while hoarding salt bag. Yellow, mischievous, secretive.

cards.power: The Fortress-Expansion. Kidney turns into a Cluster-of-Water-Balloons, destroying filters.
cards.lore: Genetic Source-Code-Glitch. Cilia-Sensors in tubes fail, causing Tubes-to-Balloon.
cards.gradeReason: Cilia-Sensors fail into Tubes-to-Balloon — ciliopathy mechanism inside a bubble frog.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green frog covered in rainbow water bubbles of all sizes, threatening to float away. Buoyant, genetic.

cards.power: The Filter-Hole. Kidney-Mesh tears, leaking Albumin-Shields into urine.
cards.lore: Loss of Negative-Charge-Barrier. Without Albumin-Magnets, water leaks into Leg-Puddles.
cards.gradeReason: Albumin-Shields leak through Filter-Hole, water floods Leg-Puddles. Nephrotic triad in one card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Moth eating through glowing net mesh, gold coins falling into purple pool below. Dark, cellular.

cards.power: The Muscle-Melt. Relaxes Smooth-Muscle-Grip of Prostate-Gate for wide Tunnel-Exit.
cards.lore: Does not shrink the gland. Simply Relaxes-the-Clench to improve Stream-Speed.
cards.gradeReason: Relaxes-the-Clench without shrinking — alpha-1A selectivity distinction embedded in lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cute blue caterpillar breathing mist that swings ornate iron gate wide open. Soft, pastel, hopeful.

cards.power: The Hormone-Starve. Cuts off DHT-Fuel for Gatekeeper-Gland. Wither-and-Shrink.
cards.lore: Blocks Testosterone to DHT conversion. Reduces Volume-of-the-Obstacle slowly.
cards.gradeReason: Wither-and-Shrink over six months — 5-alpha reductase mechanism in a vulture on a rock.
cards.artworkPrompt: Grey vulture perching on slowly shrinking stone mass, purple glow fading. Slow, patient, purple-grey.

cards.power: The Spasm-Mute. Calms the Hyper-Active-Muscle to stop Urge-the-Impulse.
cards.lore: Blocks Acetylcholine-Signal. High efficacy, but triggers side effect: The-Dry-Mouth.
cards.gradeReason: Spasm-Mute with Dry-Mouth — M3 anticholinergic trade-off built right into the lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Fluffy sheep tucking agitated red bladder balloon under starry night blanket. Soft, calm, pastel blue.

cards.power: The Reservoir-Expander. Relaxes bladder during Filling-Phase to comfortably hold more.
cards.lore: Mimics Sympathetic-Relaxation. A clean Power-Move avoiding the Anticholinergic-Fog.
cards.gradeReason: Avoiding Anticholinergic-Fog — differentiation from Oxybu built into lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Pink flamingo expanding rose-colored balloon gently in warm sunset tones. Elegant, pastel, calm.

cards.power: The Stagnant-Trap. Blood enters Erectile-Arena but cannot leave. Cells suffocate.
cards.lore: Compartment-Syndrome. If Trap isn't broken via aspiration, tissue turns to Scar.
cards.gradeReason: Blood enters but cannot leave — cells suffocate. Compartment-Syndrome in nine words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Dark red rhino trapped behind yellow hazard tape walls, smoky black emergency atmosphere.

cards.power: The Ring-Choke. Retracted Skin-Collar becomes a Tourniquet, strangling the Head.
cards.lore: Mechanical trap. Lymphatic-Return is blocked, triggering a Vicious-Cycle of swelling.
cards.gradeReason: Tourniquet Skin-Collar triggers Vicious-Cycle of swelling — reduction urgency built in.
cards.artworkPrompt: Black and white snake tightly coiling around engorged purple sphere on pedestal. Constricting, dark.

cards.power: The Wall-Burst. High-pressure armor rips; blood floods Scrotal-Plains.
cards.lore: Bending force on Erect-Pillar. A true Surgical-Repair-Emergency.
cards.gradeReason: Audible Snap plus Eggplant deformity in stat box — clinical pearls baked into card corners.
cards.artworkPrompt: Praying mantis snapping rigid structure as red blood bursts outward. Black white red, dramatic.

cards.power: The Toxic-Overflow. Blocked/Infected Kidney pushes bacteria into blood under high pressure.
cards.lore: The most lethal Uro-Match. Drain-the-Fortress immediately to stop the Storm.
cards.gradeReason: Drain-the-Fortress immediately. One action card with one life-saving instruction.
cards.artworkPrompt: Toxic green dragon emerging from infected kidney under lightning storm. Green black, systemic, urgent.

cards.lore: Often follows Strep-Infection. Filter-Membrane damaged by Immune-Comples-Shrapnel.
cards.gradeReason: Immune-Comples-Shrapnel post-Strep — GN timeline and mechanism in one wolf pack.
cards.artworkPrompt: Three white wolves tearing red filter tubes apart in bloody cola-red water arena. Aggressive, red.

cards.lore: Acute Tubular Necrosis. Most common cause of Sudden-Kidney-Halt in the ICU-Arena.
cards.gradeReason: Melting tubes shed dead cells into Drain-Pipe — ATN cast formation explained visually.
cards.artworkPrompt: Zombie pipe melting and dissolving into brown sludge over industrial drain. Muddy brown and grey.

cards.gradeReason: Innocent bystander in Drug-Hypersensitivity-Riot — AIN mechanism in seven words.
cards.artworkPrompt: Spotted leopard attacking industrial blue pipes in orange flame battle-zone. Hot, allergic, chaotic.

cards.power: The Starvation-Signal. Inflow-Pipe narrowed. Kidney thinks Arena-is-Dry, screams for Pressure.

cards.gradeReason: Kidney thinks Arena-is-Dry, screams for Pressure — RAAS feedback loop in one metaphor.
cards.artworkPrompt: Eagle claw gripping red artery pipe while panicked orange bird blares megaphone. Purple, alarmed.

cards.lore: Vesicoureteral Reflux. Illegal-Backflow carries Bacteria-Punks to Kidney-Fortress.
cards.gradeReason: Bacteria-Punks riding Splash-Back-Up — reflux and recurrent UTI mechanism in a salmon waterfall.
cards.artworkPrompt: Rainbow salmon swimming upward through waterfall of glittering blue urine. Colorful, defiant, watery.

cards.power: The Birth-Block. Skin-Flap in tunnel blocks the exit, causing Total-System-Backup before birth.
cards.lore: Posterior Urethral Valves. Bladder-Warrior hypertrophies trying to push past.
cards.gradeReason: Birth-Block causing Total-System-Backup before birth — fetal obstruction sequence explained.
cards.artworkPrompt: Crowned fat frog blocking fantasy exit gate, stork flying overhead with baby bundle. Colorful, pediatric.

cards.power: The Short-Tunnel. Exit-Pipe falls short, opening along the Bottom-Shaft instead of tip.
cards.lore: Failure of the urogenital folds to Zip-up completely during the Creation-Phase.
cards.gradeReason: Urogenital folds fail to Zip-up — embryological failure in a seahorse with broken zipper.
cards.artworkPrompt: Seahorse with incomplete zipper closure along ventral surface, water bubbling out mid-body. Embryonic.

cards.power: The Womb-Stayer. Testis fails to descend, staying in Abdominal-Heat-Zone where it withers.
cards.lore: Requires Orchiopexy-Fix (Surgical-Anchor) before permanent damage to Sperm-Knights.
cards.gradeReason: Abdominal-Heat-Zone withers Sperm-Knights — orchiopexy timing is the clinical hook.
cards.artworkPrompt: Armored owl hiding in hot amber attic while empty dark lower room waits. Warm above, cold below.

cards.gradeReason: Tamed-Bacteria trigger Immune-Fire destroying TCC-Crawler by accident. That IS BCG.
cards.artworkPrompt: Green glowing ants swarming inside dark pink bladder cave, orange fire and sparks. Controlled chaos.

cards.artworkPrompt: Silver robotic spider with purple glowing eyes working in dark anatomical cave. Precise, technological.

cards.power: The Mitosis-Stop. Freezes the Cell-Skeleton so the Miner cannot divide.
cards.lore: Microtubule stabilizer. Locks cancer cells in a permanent Ice-Stasis until they die.
cards.gradeReason: Freezes Cell-Skeleton into Ice-Stasis — taxane MOA in one blue polar bear.
cards.artworkPrompt: White polar bear breathing ice crystal freeze onto spiky blue cancer monster. Arctic blue and white.

cards.power: The Internal-Sniper. Radioactive-Calcium-Mimic goes straight to Bone-Scars, blasting tumor.
cards.lore: Targeted Alpha Therapy. High energy but Short-Range, sparing nearby Marrow-Knights.
cards.gradeReason: Calcium-Mimic finds Bone-Scars, Short-Range spares Marrow-Knights. Targeted alpha in two lines.
cards.artworkPrompt: Purple radioactive wasp firing alpha beam at brown bone fragment, precise short range. Purple glow.

cards.power: The Direct-Witness. Sends a Camera-Snake to see TCC-Crawler or Stone-Stunner face-to-face.
cards.lore: Gold Standard for bladder secrets. Allows for a Biopsy-Bite to confirm the name.
cards.gradeReason: Camera-Snake plus Biopsy-Bite cross-referencing TCC-Crawler and Stone-Stunner within ecosystem.
cards.artworkPrompt: Metallic camera snake with blue glowing eye navigating pink tunnel toward red target. Clinical detective.

cards.power: The Stream-Judge. Weak-and-Dribbling stream means BPH-the-Gatekeeper is winning.
cards.lore: Functional plumbing test. Maps Squeeze-Power versus the Resistance-Wall.
cards.gradeReason: Weak-and-Dribbling means Gatekeeper wins — cross-deck linking is elegant.
cards.artworkPrompt: Cheetah leaping over blue flow graph peaks and valleys, red crosshair targeting peak. Dynamic, data.

cards.power: The Left-Behind-Checker. Scans Reservoir after voiding. If Bucket-is-Half-Pull, plumbing fails.
cards.lore: Volume > 100ml is a Red-Flag-Signal for Overflow-the-Drip or chronic obstruction.
cards.gradeReason: Bucket-is-Half-Pull equals PVR concept. 100ml threshold buried in clinical lore.
cards.artworkPrompt: Bloodhound sniffing around large corroded industrial tank, dripping pipes around it. Brown, investigative.

cards.power: The Waste-Counter. As Kidney-Filters fail, Trash-Tokens build up in the blood.
cards.lore: A lagging indicator. If Creati is high, the Kidney-Fortress has been under siege for some time.
cards.gradeReason: Lagging indicator — Kidney-Fortress already under siege by the time Creati reads high.
cards.artworkPrompt: Scholarly owl at smoking abacus in dark library calculating accumulating waste tokens. Dusty, academic.

cards.power: The Plumbing-Orchestrator.
cards.lore: Is the stone moving? Is the pressure rising? Check the PSA, check the flow, and never forget the digital exam! Stay fluffy!
cards.gradeReason: Check the PSA, the flow, never forget the digital exam — attending mindset as a card.
cards.artworkPrompt: Yellow rabbit in cowboy hat wielding wrench and laser scope, blue lightning. Heroic, warm, detailed.

cards.cardName: FrizzleBob's Synthesis Quest 1: The Screaming Stone
cards.lore: Sudden 10/10 flank pain, vomiting, unable to sit still. UA-Scanner shows Red-Blood-Cells. QUEST: Identify the Tunnel-Blocker (Stone-the-Stunner) and decide if he needs the Wave-Smasher (ESWL).
cards.gradeReason: Scenario card cross-linking Stone-the-Stunner and ESWL-the-Wave-Smasher. Clear diagnostic task.
cards.artworkPrompt: Screaming stone creature wedged in pink tunnel, UA scanner readout visible above. Medical, urgent, narrative.

cards.cardName: FrizzleBob's Synthesis Quest 2: The Blocked Gate
cards.lore: Older wrestler can't pee. Reservoir is massive/painful. History of Weak-Stream. QUEST: Apply the Bypass-Pipe (Foley-the-Catheter) and name the Gatekeeper-Antagonist (BPH-the-Gatekeeper).
cards.gradeReason: Retention scenario linking Foley and BPH diagnosis. Classic LUTS clinical vignette.
cards.artworkPrompt: Older wrestler clutching painful distended abdomen, Foley catheter snake approaching. Clinical, narrative.

cards.cardName: FrizzleBob's Synthesis Quest 3: The Newborn's Keyhole
cards.lore: Newborn-Knight has not peed. Ultrasound shows Keyhole-Sign and bilateral Hydro-the-High-Pressure. QUEST: Identify the Exit-Wall (PUV-the-Exit-Wall) and the immediate drainage move.
cards.gradeReason: PUV diagnosis from keyhole sign — pediatric synthesis linking PUV and Hydro cards.
cards.artworkPrompt: Newborn knight in neonatal ward, ultrasound showing keyhole shadow. Soft hospital tones. Pediatric urgent.

verdict: The Renal Reservoir is the most comprehensive MedKayfab deck produced — 56 cards covering the full urology spectrum from BPH to neonatal PUV with zero dead-weight. The metaphor system is airtight: every wrestler name contains the diagnosis, every power is the mechanism, every lore is a teaching pearl. The Synthesis Quest cards on the final page are a genuine pedagogical innovation. Minor weakness: the diagnostic tool cards (pages 13-14) trend G2 — they describe rather than invoke performance. Table-ready: Yes.
blurb: 56 urology wrestlers covering every condition from kidney stones to necrotizing fasciitis. For med students who want the diagnosis to live in their body, not their notes.

marketingText:
MedKayfab: UROLOGY – The Renal Reservoir (Medical Mnemonics Cut & Play Comic)

56 illustrated medical mnemonic cards to master obstruction and stones, the urologic cancers, and the emergencies that give you hours, not days.

Almost every urologic disaster is the same physics wearing a different costume: fluid that needs to move, and a pipe that refuses to let it. Back the pressure up behind a stone and the kidney starts to die quietly, no drama, no warning, just function bleeding away. Choke the blood supply to a twisted testicle and you have about six hours before the tissue is gone for good. Let polymicrobial rot loose in the perineum and it eats through tissue faster than you can consent the patient for theatre. Urology looks like plumbing until you remember that plumbing under pressure is never a slow emergency.

MedKayfab Urology translates the high-pressure logic of obstruction, malignancy, and uro-emergency into a narrative wrestling match. You do not recite the differential for a screaming flank. You learn to feel which pipe is blocked, where the pressure is heading next, and how long you have before it wins.

YOU'LL GET
- 56 illustrated MedKayfab cards (14pp, 4 cards/page)
- Full MedKayfab Freestyle rules (Quest Die mechanics)
- S-Tier characters like Torsion-the-Twister, Fournier-the-Grit-Destroyer, and BCG-the-Immune-Fire
- Three FrizzleBob Synthesis Quests that force you to cross-reference whole cases instead of recalling cards in isolation
- Free lifetime updates as guidelines evolve
- CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 licence
- PDF optimized for home printing (A4 / Letter)

What's in the deck
The roster runs the full pipeline, from BPH-the-Gatekeeper throttling the outflow to Stone-the-Stunner lodged where it hurts the most. Three carry the deck. Torsion-the-Twister is the bell-clapper testicle that spins on its own cord and chokes its own arterial supply, starting the cruelest clock in the specialty. Fournier-the-Grit-Destroyer is the polymicrobial firestorm that melts scrotal tissue in hours and punishes every minute of hesitation. BCG-the-Immune-Fire is the tamed tuberculosis bug you pour into a bladder on purpose, a controlled riot that burns superficial cancer out from the inside. The deck is sequenced the way a rotation actually teaches you: obstruction, then cancer, then the scrotal emergencies, then infection, voiding, procedures, medications, and the uro-emergencies that close the show.

How it works
Every card is a cognitive anchor. You have the Character (the mnemonic), the Visual (the scene), the Stat Block (the numbers and red flags), the Lore (the clinical story), and the Quest (the challenge).
